Description: Divayth Fyr's mind worked quickly to infuse part of his lost shadow essence into this cast-off brigandine.

Item Name: Apostle garb is stiff and inflexible, much like the Apostles themselves.
The Shadow of Sotha Sil slipped through your fingers. It won't next time.
Even the act of betrayal has its place in Apostle philosophy.
The Whispering Shadows cult that serves Nocturnal crafts its armor with threads of living shadow pulled from the streams of Evergloam.

Description: The Clockwork Apostles furnish their proctors with the most finely-crafted armor in the Clockwork City.
You served Sotha Sil well, and in exchange he presented you with this garment common to initiates of the Clockwork Apostles.
The rich loam of the Everwound Wellspring is a rare and precious resource, and should be handled with gentle care.
With all of the sparking, burning, and bladed objects in the Clockwork City, having good protection at knee level is considered essential.
"You know," Dalomar mused, "the Shrikes don't wear clothes. I wonder why the cultists bother."
Even something as simple as a belt is a metaphor in Clockwork theology. In this case, the movement of celestial spheres and planes.
This tough belt is made from a rubbery strap leftover from Terari's exchange machine.
Tightly sealed boots are important when moving through Evergloam, lest small Daedric creatures wriggle their way into the spaces between.
It doesn't take a prognosticating factotum to know that a good pair of shoes can save you a lot of grief.

Item Name: Raynor cobbled these boots together from spare parts found during your exploration of the Clockwork City.
